Vance made the remarks on an episode of The Sean Spicer Show that aired Friday. He said he talks about TrumpRx in every speech.

"It is one of the most significant achievements… as much as the Democrats talk about how they care about drug affordability and pharmaceutical prices, Donald Trump actually did something about it," Vance said.

TrumpRx is the administration’s effort to lower prescription costs. Vance said it began when Trump pressed drugmakers over pricing, claiming they charge European buyers about 20% of U.S. prices. He said Trump threatened penalties, and the companies agreed.
Vance did not name the companies. The host, however, cited GLP-1 drugs, popular diabetes and weight-loss medications, as an example of household savings.

Can Trump Accounts Build Long-Term Wealth?
Vance then turned to Trump Accounts, which he framed as a way to give children a stake in the future. He said he wants "a generation of Americans who own something."

Vance described a child with $2,000 in an account growing to "tens of thousands of dollars" by age 18, without specifying investments or returns.
He tied both policies to "economic nationalism," which he said aims to help Americans build "a little bit of a cushion" beyond paycheck-to-paycheck living.
